report:
Intervertebral disc, L4/5, discectomy

Received in formalin are fragments of grey-white cartilaginous tissue labelled L4/5, measuring 2 x 1.5 x 0.5 cm in aggregate. All embedded in 1 block.

(1) Disc fragments, all embedded.

Sections show fragments of intervertebral disc fibrocartilage with degenerative change, including chondrocyte clusters and fissuring of the matrix. There is ingrowth of small blood vessels. No acute inflammation is seen. There is no evidence of malignancy.

INTERVERTEBRAL DISC, L4/5, discectomy - DEGENERATIVE CHANGE
